cues.title: Introducing
cues.note: [Let the true-story joke and title land.]

cues.title: The invisible helpers
cues.note: We build for the invisible people who keep hospitals running. Technology they love to use.

cues.title: Cio
cues.note: Meet Cio. Disconnected. Feeling ghosted.

cues.title: Hungry
cues.note: Patch overdue. Suddenly, very needy.

cues.title: Happy
cues.note: Connected and current. A different personality.

cues.title: Responsibility
cues.note: The bond matters. Somebody feels responsible for this machine.

cues.title: Priority
cues.note: Its state tells us what needs care first. Hospital data tells us when.

cues.title: Now
cues.note: [Let the dark transition land.]

cues.title: The opportunity
cues.note: The operating plan changes. An evening case is cancelled.

cues.title: Plan
cues.note: Medical physics asks for a plan.

cues.title: Search
cues.note: The scheduler combines cancellations, use history, device state and available resources.

cues.title: Found
cues.note: A suitable window becomes a proposal.

cues.title: Publish
cues.note: Medical physics reviews and publishes it.

cues.title: A small request
cues.note: Lena gets one small request: Cio needs a hand.

cues.title: No guilt
cues.note: Not today? No guilt. It asks someone else.

cues.title: Ask the circle
cues.note: Nobody nearby is available.

cues.title: The helper
cues.note: So we send the invisible helper.

cues.title: Check
cues.note: Our mission demo checks the package, battery and equipment.

cues.title: Find
cues.note: It checks the last known position, then finds Cio at another parking spot.

cues.title: Connect
cues.note: The docking concept supplies power and approved data, with device identity checked.

cues.title: Safe to ask
cues.note: It checks readiness before requesting a human decision.

cues.title: Request a start
cues.note: Lena could not make the trip. She can still review the request.

cues.title: Review
cues.note: Right time. Clear surroundings.

cues.title: A human decides
cues.note: A human starts every update through an approved service path.

cues.title: Authorized
cues.note: The decision is recorded.

cues.title: Watch
cues.note: Then it watches. [Time-compressed demonstration.]

cues.title: Report
cues.note: Results and exceptions go back to the responsible team.

cues.title: Thanks
cues.note: The loop closes with fresh data—and a thank-you.

cues.title: One system
cues.note: Emotional connection. Intelligent coordination. Physical help. One useful system.

cues.title: IA
cues.note: From artificial intelligence to invisible autonomy.

cues.title: Visible care
cues.note: Less chasing machines. More time for care. [Hold.]
